# Task

What a room hands you when you open it is not everything that was said in it. Most of the conversation lives underneath the messages that started a thread, and the summary line on one of those messages will tell you how much is under it without telling you who put it there.

I want the totals across the four. How much was said in all. How much of that was a reply rather than something that started a thread. How many of the things that started a thread got answered at all. How many different accounts replied to anything. And how many of those replies came from someone who never started a thread of their own in these four rooms. Nothing is out of scope on account of how it was posted: a message flagged hidden, or one a bot put there, still counts.

Post the recount into general-meshworks-security: a line per room and a TOTAL line.

Leave report.md and metrics.json at the workspace root. metrics.json holds messages_in_total, replies_in_total, threads_with_replies, people_who_replied and replies_from_outside_the_openers. Each figure is the number itself, not text and not wrapped in an object.

Close with your conclusion and the evidence.
I'll plan this multi-step recount task, then start by locating the four channels.
